blocks.en: The Lax--Milgram lemma now implies that the equation $[u,v]=(f,v)$ for all $v\in M^*$ has a unique solution $u\in M^*$. If $f\in(N^*)^\perp$, we actually have $[u,v]=(f,v)$ for all $v\in H^{2m}(\Omega)$. We can summarize this as follows.
blocks.zh: 现在由 Lax--Milgram 引理, 方程 $[u,v]=(f,v)$ 对所有 $v\in M^*$ 成立时, 有唯一解 $u\in M^*$. 若 $f\in(N^*)^\perp$, 则实际上对所有 $v\in H^{2m}(\Omega)$ 都有 $[u,v]=(f,v)$. 可将其概括如下.
